penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Field sales tracking requires GPS/mobile app integration, territory configuration per customer, and ongoing per-team setup — this is fundamentally a mobile SaaS product, not a Claude-prompt service.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Selling to ops managers at regional FMCG/pharma companies in South/Southeast Asia virtually always requires demos and onboarding calls; self-serve is unrealistic for this segment.

rationale: The pain is real and frequent — distributed field sales managers genuinely suffer from spreadsheet chaos — and paid competitors confirm budget exists. However, the actual product needed is a mobile app with GPS tracking, real-time rep location, and territory management: none of that is buildable as a Claude prompt plus a landing page by a solo non-technical operator. Operational autonomy is near zero because every customer needs custom territory setup, mobile app deployment for reps, and ongoing support for a field workforce. This is a well-served market with strong incumbents (Salesforce Maps, FieldAssist) that requires a proper mobile engineering team, not a Claude factory.
solution_plan: This opportunity is not viable for a solo non-technical operator using this factory. The core product (GPS-verified field rep tracking across multiple cities) requires a native or PWA mobile app, real-time location services, and per-customer territory configuration — none of which can be assembled from Claude prompts and a Stripe link. The incumbents (FieldAssist, Badger Maps) are already well-funded. Drop and redirect attention to the LLM observability opportunities in this batch, which are genuinely buildable here.
notes: build_gate failed: buildability_with_ai=3 (below min 6), operational_autonomy=2 (below min 7), buyer_clarity=7 (passes), willingness_to_pay=7 (passes). Total 2.9 is below min_total_to_validate threshold of 5.5 after penalties. Drop recommended.
